capabilities: Review selected passages or scenes for continuity, craft, and clarity errors
Keep and rewrite per-novel notes on characters, places, timeline, threads, and outline
Chat in character about the story with per-note conversation history
Apply suggested rewrites to the note only on explicit Apply
Configure provider, tone, review depth, and what findings to mention
extras: No release on Community yet for end users: the README says to clone, run npm ci and npm run build, and have the build copy the plugin into the vault named in .vaultpath. Sends passage and novel text to the chosen AI provider; OpenAI and Gemini requests explicitly opt out of provider request storage. Automatic chapter reading after edits is on by default and should be turned off if unwanted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get continuity checks, craft feedback, or story-bible-style notes maintained automatically while drafting long fiction.

relations.evidence: Lyra uses network access to send review and chat text to the AI provider you choose

requires.name: Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or OpenRouter API key

summary: Story-aware AI companion that reviews fiction passages for continuity and craft, keeps novel notes, and chats in character.
